shortAcceptance: Shipped engine: 32-step 你好 and 谢谢 both independently recognized correctly, with 2.0s generated PCM; no padding added. Original 16-step controls match 你好 and 谢谢.
longAcceptance: Unchanged 32-step long control matches 今天的天气很好我们一起去公园散步 (traditional/simplified and punctuation equivalents); 16-step control has a recognition difference at 散步. Not all texts/references passed verbatim.
selectedPolicy: Only reference-backed zh 32-step one/two-Han-character generation uses a 50-frame / speed floor. 16 steps, long texts, other languages and reference-free generation preserve previous duration.
timingScope: 2.0 seconds is audio length, not generation wall time. Host timing cannot establish phone speed.
